title: Collaborative Constitutional Review
subtitle: Phase 8 penultimate human-governance layer — academic peer-review journal model; Impact Requests bridge to Phase 9 Systems Intelligence

phase_placement.steve_intent_note: Corrected order (CC-DEC-097): Collaborative Review is Phase 8; Systems Intelligence Engine is Phase 9 true capstone. Manuscript remains Phase 6; education/publication packages are Phase 7.

principle.text: People should not merely comment. They should help improve the document as scholarly reviewers.

psychology_shift.to: I believe this section could be stronger because...

why_last.text: Only after architecture, evidence, legal review, modeling, manuscript, and education layers are mature should the public be invited into drafting. Collaboration is the final human-governance layer before the intelligence capstone.
why_last.embodiment: Prosperity grows through participation — scholarly review strengthens the document; the Systems Intelligence Engine then lets people test assumptions across the whole system under human authority.

is_not: Public feedback backend on an unprotected Build Board
Opinion threads without expertise or review-type metadata
is: Evidence-first collaboration aligned with Proof Burden discipline
Impact Requests that feed the Systems Intelligence Engine

identity_model.title: Anonymous — but Accountable
identity_model.registration: Establishes identity for moderation and internal reputation

manuscript_tree.title: Every Level Can Be Commented On
manuscript_tree.interaction: Highlight a unit → Comment → discussion attaches only to that node (Google-Docs-like permanence and structure).

comment_types.note: High volume of confusion on one paragraph means the paragraph is the problem.
comment_types.title: Clarifying Question

margin_system.title: Margin Conversations
margin_system.text: True margin annotation — legal annotation / academic peer review / convention notes — not comments stacked underneath the text. Click expands margin discussion.

version_awareness.title: Version Awareness
version_awareness.rule: Every comment belongs to a manuscript version. When text changes, prior comments collapse automatically.

ai_assistant.title: Discussion Summaries
ai_assistant.note: AI summarizes; humans decide. Does not replace scholarly judgment.

contributor_reputation.title: Internal Reputation Ladder
contributor_reputation.rule: Authority is earned through quality of contributions, not popularity.

decision_ledger.title: Nothing Disappears
decision_ledger.purpose: Transparent legislative history for the project

scholarly_modes.title: Scholarly Mode — one manuscript, multiple lenses

review_artifacts.title: Reviews as scholarly artifacts
review_artifacts.rule: Every submission should be capable of becoming a tracked review artifact with expertise, type, and permanent audit trail — journal peer review, not a comment widget.

all_required: Phase 2 proof standards materially satisfied (or honest Phase 2.1 completion path)
Legal review no longer 0% for reviewed claims
Economic modeling no longer 0% for modeled claims
Manuscript sufficiently mature for sentence-level review
Public Education Edition available so citizens can understand context
Build Board / review platform protection confirmed
Moderation, identity, and reputation systems designed and tested
Version-aware comment attachment implemented before public launch

related_existing_slice.status: APPROVED PARALLEL / NOT ACTIVE IN THIS MISSION
related_existing_slice.rule: No public feedback backend on unprotected Build Board. CCR is the Phase 8 peer-review design; Impact Requests connect to Phase 9 Systems Intelligence when activated.

implementation_status.phase_2_action: Capture architecture only. Do not implement commenting, registration, or public review backends.

governance_vs_construction.title: Governance separated from construction
governance_vs_construction.rule: While Constitutional Capitalism is still being constructed, collaboration is premature — reviewers would debate ideas not yet fully researched, modeled, or legally analyzed.
governance_vs_construction.opens_when: Architecture is mature enough that outside expertise can improve it rather than define it.

operating_model.title: Academic peer-review journal — not an online commenting platform
operating_model.principle: People should not merely comment. They should help improve the document as reviewers.

psychology_shift.to: I believe this section could be stronger because...

expertise_domains.title: Primary Expertise (disciplinary — not political identity)
expertise_domains.rule: Reviewers register by discipline and professional background; optional analytical frameworks. Not partisan labels.

review_types.title: Clarifying Question
review_types.note: High volume of confusion on one paragraph means the paragraph is the problem.

impact_requests.title: Impact Requests
impact_requests.rule: Instead of opinion-only comments, a reviewer may submit a structured Impact Request for system-level analysis.
impact_requests.example_submission: I think we should increase local investment from 10% to 15%.
impact_requests.transforms: Collaboration from opinion into structured systems analysis.
impact_requests.authority: AI analyzes Impact Requests; humans review; authorized humans decide; decision ledger records the outcome. AI never auto-modifies doctrine.

five_stage_progression.title: Natural evolution of the build

stages.title: Understand
stages.summary: AI systems intelligence, simulation, and impact analysis
stages.note: AI helps everyone understand consequences of changing the work — not write it.

five_stage_progression.note: Review (Phase 8) precedes Understand (Phase 9). The AI does not become the author; it becomes the instrument for understanding consequences of change.

architecture_freeze.rule: High-level roadmap stable. Do not expand Phase 8 architecture further in Phase 2.

reviewers_charter.rule: Deferred charter for first scholarly collaborators. Objective: intellectual seriousness, not conviction. Does not activate Phase 8.

culture.note: Serious scholars appreciate being invited to improve a framework rather than endorse it.

registration_model.rule: Register by disciplinary perspective and optionally by analytical framework — not by political identity labels (e.g., libertarian, conservative, progressive as registration categories).
forbids: partisan labels as required profile fields

analytical_perspectives_optional.title: Analytical Perspectives (optional)
analytical_perspectives_optional.purpose: Allow AI and future readers to understand the lens of a review without reducing reviewers to partisan labels.

multi_perspective_review.title: Multi-perspective review
multi_perspective_review.rule: Far more valuable than 100 general comments: the same doctrine reviewed by distinct professional perspectives.

coverage_dashboard.title: Reviewer coverage dashboards (much later)
coverage_dashboard.note: Ensure major disciplines have meaningfully engaged relevant parts of the framework — not unanimous agreement.

founding_steward.not: author as sole identity during Beta
founding_steward.beta_rule: Founding Steward is the BETA collaborator and goes through the entire build before anyone else.
responsibilities: ensuring the system behaves as designed
founding_steward.software_analogy: First end-to-end user of the governance system

beta_simulation.rule: During Beta, do not review only as yourself. Intentionally adopt different roles and ask: What would this reviewer object to?

founding_steward.distinction: Founding Steward (Steve, Beta) exercises the whole system. Domain Stewards are long-term independent subject-matter reviewers for specific disciplines — not the same role.

panel_purpose.text: Assemble a panel to stress-test the framework from fundamentally different domains of expertise — not to reach consensus.

domain_steward.title: Domain Steward
domain_steward.rule: Once the project reaches that stage, think of long-term subject-matter reviewers as Domain Stewards — not primarily as collaborators seeking agreement.
domain_steward.core_question: Has this domain been treated fairly, rigorously, and accurately?
engineer_helps_determine: whether the system behaves coherently under stress
whether hidden dependencies or failure modes have been overlooked

independence.title: Preserve independence
independence.ask: Will you independently review this work within your area of expertise and tell us where it is strong, where it is weak, and where it requires further research?
independence.why: If reviewers become advocates, readers may question objectivity. Independent experts carry more weight—even when they disagree.

review_ecosystem.title: Review ecosystem (deferred)

roles.title: Domain Steward
roles.core_question: Has this domain been treated fairly, rigorously, and accurately?
roles.not: Expected to agree with the framework or certify that proposals are optimal

roles.title: Contributing Reviewer
roles.role: Specialist who reviews specific proof packets

roles.title: Methodology Reviewer
roles.role: Expert who evaluates the research process itself

roles.title: Cross-Domain Reviewer
roles.role: Spans multiple disciplines; identifies interactions between fields

review_ecosystem.aligns_with: evidence, transparency, and disciplined inquiry — not consensus-building

future_endorsement_ideal.text: I disagree with several conclusions, but the work accurately represents my field, engages the strongest counterarguments, and treats the evidence honestly.
future_endorsement_ideal.value: Speaks to integrity of process rather than agreement with outcome

review_culture.is: A community of independent scholarly reviewers
review_culture.is_not: An advisory board that guides the organization
review_culture.distinction: An advisory board tends to help guide the organization. An independent scholarly community helps evaluate the work itself. Independence carefully preserved becomes a strength.

three_kinds_of_truth.title: Design judgment
three_kinds_of_truth.question: Assuming our values are accepted, what institutional design best advances them?
